labels.name: not_related
labels.description: The current text and candidate event are not narratively relevant.

labels.name: weak_related
labels.description: There is some shared context, but the relation is indirect or weak.

labels.name: strong_related
labels.description: The current text directly depends on, continues, recalls, updates, or is constrained by the candidate event.

labels.name: same_event
labels.description: The two texts refer to the same narrative event in different wording.

labels.name: uncertain
labels.description: The relation cannot be determined from the given inputs alone.
